coordinate_evaluation_rule.qutrit_weyl_convention: Z diagonal with Z_00=1; X and X^2 have zero diagonal at (0,0); ZX and ZX^2 inherit the off-diagonal X support

exactness_or_error_bound_certificate.reason: Only exact rational I and Z coefficients contribute at coordinate (0,0).

selected_primitive_kernel_formula: K_{u,phase;00} = <psi_L,0, V_phase psi_R,0 H_u> + <delta_phase psi_L,0, V_0 psi_R,0 H_u> + <psi_L,0, V_0 delta_phase psi_R,0 H_u> + <psi_L,0, V_0 psi_R,0 delta_phase H_u> + HessianCounterterm_u^phase[0,0]

selected_trace_or_pairing_source.pairing: <A,B>_C1 = Re Tr(A^* B) on each routed sector, summed over routed sectors

why_not_independent: The coordinate evaluation is exact and does not use observed data, but the R_Z polynomial packet is still the residual-projector polynomial source.  Full Route-B independence requires a row source not inherited from that replay, or Route-A physical Phi_fin^C1 action-source promotion.
